description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter application named 'Recipe Explorer'. It sets up the app's theme, navigation, and root widget structures, including handling bottom navigation between Home, Search, and Favorites screens.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget for the Flutter application, setting up theme and home screen.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: Stateful widget managing bottom navigation and rendering the appropriate screen.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: State class for AppShell, managing navigation state.

classes.name: _TabSpec
classes.description: Helper class to define tab specifications including title, icon, and the associated page widget.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes the app by running the MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method in MyApp and _AppShellState; constructs the widget tree for application and navigation shell.
